content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** § 28.1 imposed Singapore law and exclusive Singapore courts — outside the accepted list and walk-away territory — and contradicted § 28.2, which already gives the New York County state and federal courts exclusive jurisdiction (with only a customary temporary-injunctive-relief carve-out, which does not defeat that exclusive merits forum). I proposed a single surgical replacement in § 28.1 substituting New York law and dropping the conflicting Singapore forum words, leaving § 28.2 and the § 28.3 escalation untouched. The venue element was mapped as already met by § 28.2's verbatim language rather than re-drafted.
